note: Equivalence classes between the two slicers' model names. There is no
canonical spelling to invent: an author writes the name they know, from
either slicer, and both renders resolve. Curated by hand — a missing entry
surfaces as a render error naming the model, never as a silent mismatch.
Two families so far. Punctuation and casing (Elegoo Neptune 3 vs
Neptune-3), and the vendor prefix Orca puts in the model name while Prusa
leaves it to the vendor file: 'Sovol SV06' vs plain 'SV06'.
Deliberately ABSENT: the Orca models 'Prusa MK4S HF', 'Prusa CORE One HF'
and 'Prusa CORE One L HF'. Orca models high-flow as a separate machine,
PrusaSlicer as a nozzle_high_flow flag on the same one. Aliasing them to
the non-HF model would render a condition that quietly matches the wrong
hardware; a hard error is the honest answer until the flag is mapped.
